entry.name: CustomGroups
entry.label: Custom sections, one "Title: regex" per line, matched against each shortcut's label and action id

entry.name: HidePattern
entry.label: Hide shortcuts whose label, action id or "Component: label" matches this regex

entry.name: SplitScripts
entry.label: Give KWin scripts' shortcuts ("Script: action") their own sections

entry.name: GroupHardwareKeys
entry.label: Put shortcuts on media, volume, brightness and power keys in one "Hardware keys" section at the end

entry.name: UseCustomAccent
entry.label: Use a custom accent colour instead of the colour scheme's highlight
